about_the_game:
The Original Soundtrack for Operation Octo!

Created by composers Daniel Teles, and Tiago Massochin

Contains all in-game tracks in MP3 and high-quality lossless FLAC, as well as loopable versions of those biome themes!
(and... a sneak peek at the Volcanic Ridge theme?! 👀)

The OST will also be available on YouTube & Spotify, so think of this Steam release as a tip jar for me ;)

Will be updated when new tracks are added to the game via content updates...
